_comment: The ONE price table Burn -Log derives a cost from (Scripts/Read-ClaudeUsage.ps1; docs/hub/usage.md, "The cost is derived"). List prices of the first-party API, in USD per million tokens, on the day asOf names. A cache write is priced from the input price: cacheWrite5mMultiplier for the five-minute lifetime, cacheWrite1hMultiplier for the one-hour. Thinking tokens are inside output and are not priced twice. A model with no row here is still counted, its cost is null, and the record names it under unpriced. Change a price here and nowhere else; the record says which table it used.
note: list prices; not the plan's allocation
